items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: iptv
items.summary: IPTV-org 是一个汇集全球公开 IPTV 频道的项目，解决了用户难以统一获取世界各地电视直播源的痛点。它通过 TypeScript 实现自动化管理，将数千个频道按国家、语言分类为标准化 M3U 播放列表，确保数据持续更新且易于解析。开发者可直接在 VLC、Kodi 等播放器中加载列表观看国际新闻与体育赛事，或基于其 API 构建定制化应用，例如创建专属频道导航或内容推荐系统，快速实验多源流媒体整合方案。
items.summary_en: IPTV-org is a comprehensive collection of publicly available IPTV channels that solves the challenge of accessing diverse global television streams without proprietary services. It organizes thousands of channels into structured M3U playlists using TypeScript for reliable parsing and categorization. You can integrate these playlists into media players like VLC or Kodi to instantly access international news, sports, and entertainment streams, or build custom applications using their well-documented API for personalized streaming solutions.

items.name: browser-use
items.summary: Browser-use 是一个 Python 库，旨在让 AI 智能体能够通过自动化浏览器控制与网站交互，解决语言模型难以直接访问动态网页内容的问题。它利用 Playwright 框架模拟人类的浏览行为，如点击链接、输入文本和滚动页面，使智能体能够处理需要 JavaScript 渲染的复杂网页。开发者可将它集成到 AI 工作流中，实现自动数据采集、在线表单填写或网页功能测试等任务，为构建能实际操作网络的智能应用提供强大工具。
items.summary_en: Browser-use is a Python library that enables AI agents to interact with websites through automated browser control, solving the challenge of making web content programmatically accessible to language models. It leverages Playwright to simulate human-like browsing actions like clicking and typing, allowing agents to navigate dynamic web pages that static scraping cannot handle. Developers can integrate it into AI workflows for tasks such as automated data collection, form filling, or testing web applications, providing a practical bridge between AI reasoning and real-world web interactions.

items.name: minimind
items.summary: Minimind是一个开源项目，能够在短短两小时内从零开始训练小型GPT模型，大幅降低了语言模型实验的门槛。其核心在于优化的训练流程和高效的参数配置，通过精心设计的训练策略显著缩短训练时间，同时保持模型质量。该项目让开发者能够快速原型化语言模型、尝试不同架构设计，或通过实践学习Transformer基本原理，特别适合教育场景和快速迭代实验，为理解大模型训练提供了轻量级实践平台。
items.summary_en: Minimind is an open-source project that enables training small GPT models from scratch in just two hours, making large language model experimentation accessible without extensive computational resources. Its key innovation lies in optimized training pipelines and efficient parameter configurations that dramatically reduce training time while maintaining model quality. Developers can use Minimind to quickly prototype language models, experiment with different architectures, or learn transformer fundamentals through hands-on training, making it ideal for educational purposes and rapid iteration.

items.name: tinygrad
items.summary: Tinygrad 是一个极简深度学习框架，通过将核心代码控制在 3000 行以内，让开发者能够轻松理解和修改神经网络底层实现。其技术亮点在于即时编译器动态优化计算图，无需复杂依赖即可在 CPU、GPU 及各类加速器上高效运行。你可以用它从头构建模型、尝试自定义算子，或集成到教学工具中，通过透明可修改的代码直观学习机器学习核心原理。
items.summary_en: Tinygrad is a minimalist deep learning framework that makes neural network development accessible by keeping code under 3,000 lines while maintaining full functionality. Its key innovation is a just-in-time compiler that optimizes operations on-the-fly, enabling efficient execution across CPUs, GPUs, and specialized accelerators without bloated dependencies. Developers can use it to build and train models from scratch, experiment with custom operations, or integrate it into educational tools to teach core ML concepts with transparent, hackable code.

items.name: awesome-claude-code
items.summary: Awesome Claude Code 是一个精心整理的资源集合，专门用于增强 Anthropic 的 Claude Code AI 助手在软件开发任务中的能力。该项目通过组织技能、钩子和智能体编排器等实用组件，展示了如何采用模块化设计模式来扩展 Claude 的功能。开发者可以将此仓库作为参考，实现自定义工作流、将 Claude 集成到编码环境中，或者研究如何构建 AI 智能体以处理复杂的编程辅助任务，从而提升开发效率。
items.summary_en: Awesome Claude Code is a curated collection of tools and techniques that enhance Anthropic's Claude Code AI assistant for software development tasks. It organizes practical components like skills, hooks, and agent orchestrators that demonstrate how to extend Claude's capabilities through modular design patterns. Developers can use this repository as a reference to implement custom workflows, integrate Claude into their coding environments, or study how AI agents can be structured for complex programming assistance.

items.name: obsidian-skills
items.summary: Obsidian Skills 是一个开源工具包，让 AI 智能体能够与 Obsidian 知识管理系统交互，解决了自主智能体与结构化个人知识库之间的连接难题。它通过提供专门技能模块，使智能体能够读取和处理 Markdown 文档、查询 Obsidian 图谱数据库、操作 JSON Canvas 可视化画布，并执行命令行指令，从而实现程序化访问和操作知识库。开发者可将这些技能集成到自己的智能体框架中，创建能够自动总结笔记、发现概念关联或优化知识组织流程的 AI 助手，为个人知识管理带来自动化可能。
items.summary_en: Obsidian Skills is an open-source toolkit that enables AI agents to interact with Obsidian's knowledge management ecosystem, solving the challenge of bridging autonomous agents with structured personal knowledge bases. It provides specialized skills for processing Markdown files, querying Obsidian's graph database, manipulating JSON Canvas visualizations, and executing CLI commands—allowing agents to read, analyze, and modify knowledge bases programmatically. Developers can integrate these skills into their agent frameworks to create AI assistants that can summarize notes, connect related concepts, or automate knowledge organization workflows within Obsidian vaults.

items.name: chronos-bolt-tiny
items.summary: Chronos-Bolt-Tiny 是一个轻量级时间序列预测模型，专为资源受限的边缘计算环境设计，解决了在设备端部署AI预测的难题。它采用T5架构，通过独特的标记化技术将连续时间序列数据转换为离散标记，从而能够利用预训练语言模型的能力来捕捉复杂的时间模式。该模型可通过Hugging Face管道进行微调，适用于物联网传感器监测、能源消耗预测或零售需求分析等场景，开发者只需少量数据即可快速适配特定领域，实现高效的时间序列推理。
items.summary_en: Chronos-Bolt-Tiny is a lightweight time series forecasting model that enables accurate predictions on resource-constrained devices, addressing the challenge of deploying AI forecasting in edge computing environments. It employs a T5-based architecture with tokenization techniques that convert continuous time series data into discrete tokens, allowing it to leverage pre-trained language model capabilities for temporal patterns. Developers can fine-tune it on custom datasets using Hugging Face pipelines, making it suitable for IoT sensor monitoring, energy consumption forecasting, or retail demand prediction applications where computational efficiency is critical.

items.name: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
items.summary: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 是一个大型多模态语言模型，能够同时处理图像和文本输入以生成对话式回复，解决了AI在对话中理解视觉上下文的需求。其技术核心采用混合专家架构，通过根据输入动态激活不同的专家子网络，实现了350亿参数的高效扩展，在保持强大能力的同时优化了计算资源。开发者可利用Hugging Face平台进行微调，应用于视觉问答、结合图像的智能客服等场景，或通过API集成到需要多模态交互的应用中，探索视觉与语言融合的实践。
items.summary_en: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B is a large multimodal language model that processes both images and text to generate conversational responses, addressing the need for AI that can understand visual context in dialogue. It employs a Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture, where specialized sub-networks activate selectively based on input, enabling efficient scaling to 35 billion parameters while maintaining computational feasibility. Developers can fine-tune it for applications like visual question answering or integrate it into chatbots that interpret uploaded images, using the Hugging Face transformers library for deployment.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。
